title: TARJAMAT: Evaluation of Bard and ChatGPT on Machine Translation of Ten Arabic Varieties

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation performance disparities (using automated metrics like BLEU, COMET, ChrF++, and TER, as well as human evaluation) across ten different Arabic varieties, including Classical Arabic, Modern Standard Arabic, and eight regional dialects, to reveal performance gaps between high-resource and low-resource linguistic variants.
